description: Browser-enforced HTTP header policy that restricts script sources, prevents inline execution, and blocks mixed content. Defense-in-depth against stored/reflected XSS that catches output encoding failures. CSP's frame-ancestors directive also mitigates clickjacking.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: CSP script-src directive restricts script execution to enumerated origins; injected inline scripts are blocked by the browser's enforcement engine regardless of payload encoding or obfuscation
conditions: CSP must not include unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval in script-src
script-src must be tightly scoped — no CDNs hosting user-controllable or framework-gadget content
Header must be Content-Security-Policy, not Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only
Attacker goal must require script execution — CSS/HTML injection is unaffected by CSP

verification.method: Verify CSP header is present with effective script restrictions

remediation.name: Content Security Policy header via nginx drop-in configuration

steps.description: Create an nginx drop-in configuration that adds a strict Content-Security-Policy header to all responses; adjust allowed sources per application requirements
steps.command: printf 'add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src '\''self'\''; script-src '\''self'\''; style-src '\''self'\''; img-src '\''self'\'' data:; font-src '\''self'\''; frame-ancestors '\''self'\''; base-uri '\''self'\''; form-action '\''self'\''" always;\n' > /etc/nginx/conf.d/cme-905-csp.conf

steps.description: Validate nginx configuration syntax before reloading
Reload nginx to apply the new CSP header without dropping active connections

remediation.name: Content Security Policy header via Apache httpd drop-in configuration

steps.description: Create an Apache drop-in configuration that sets a strict Content-Security-Policy header on all responses via mod_headers; adjust allowed sources per application requirements
steps.command:
printf '<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src '''self'''; script-src '''self'''; style-src '''self'''; img-src '''self''' data:; font-src '''self'''; frame-ancestors '''self'''; base-uri '''self'''; form-action '''self'''"
</IfModule>
' > /etc/httpd/conf.d/cme-905-csp.conf

steps.description: Validate Apache configuration syntax before reloading
Reload Apache to apply the new CSP header without dropping active connections
